title: Three Saturdays and One Short String
subtitle: 符号与标识 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 符号与标识（人与自我·语言与思维·符号与标识）
meta: 主题语境：符号与标识（人与自我·语言与思维·符号与标识）　|　核心词汇：label　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 label 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the printer ① printed the label that no shopper in the store would have recorded, and he said the printing was the whole of the Saturday. The ② label, meaning the mark itself and not the string, ran three Saturdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a label, he said, is the only thing in a store that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ label in that store had the same short string beside it, and the ④ label at the far counter, meaning the name they kept for the children to read and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A label, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the printer said the recording is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the label was the whole of the matter, meaning the word and not the mark. The ⑥ label, meaning the word and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; label, he said, is either something you print or the only word that means both a mark and a word. He said the word is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ label had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short string. The ⑧ label of the whole thing, the printer wrote in August, was one store and three Saturdays of recording; label, he said, is either the name at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ label I remember is the mark recorded in the list, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the store. A ⑩ label, my mother said in 1983, is the only mark that improves by being recorded; every label, she said, is a word that has agreed to look like a mark. She said the word was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 标签；标记（指铺子里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 标签；标记（指那张标签本身，与细绳相对）
C. 固定搭配：print the label 印制这张标签
D. n. 标签；标记（指留给孩子们念的那个名字那一张）
E. n. 标识之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的标签之事）
F. n. 标签；标记（指货单里写到、被登记的的那一张）
G. n. 说法、名目（指一件事里人人都贴却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 名目（抽象总称，指人人都贴却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: printed the label that no shopper in the store would have recorded
The label, meaning the mark itself and not the string
the label at the far counter
the label was the whole of the matter
the label had become a line in a list
The label of the whole thing
A label, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: print the label 意为“印制这张标签”，1974 年那位印工把铺子里没有一位顾客肯登记的一张标签做了一遍。
label 意为“标签；标记”，指那张标签本身而不是细绳，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被登记。
label 意为“标签；标记”，指铺子里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一根细细的绳子。
label 意为“标签；标记”，指最远那张柜台留给孩子们念的那个名字那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
label 意为“说法、名目”，指一件事里人人都贴却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个说法就是那件事的全部。
label 意为“名目”，指人人都贴却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张标签，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
label 意为“标签；标记”，指货单里写到、被登记的的那一张，到 1979 年这一张成了货单里的一行。
label 意为“标识之事”，印工八月写道，整件事的标签之事是一处铺子和三个星期六的登记。
label 意为“标签；标记”，我记得的是货单里登记过的那一张，1981 年贴好了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一张。
label 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，标签是唯一会因为被好好登记而变得更好的标签。

那张标签，指的是那张标签本身而不是细绳，经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被登记。（label）
